notes.title: DEMO 2.0! New Stats, Damage Formulas, Fish Animations & More!

A bobber animation has also been added to spice up fishing.[/p][/*][*][p]🎣[b]ADDED Bobbers, Lures, and Reels![/b][/p][p]-Special equipment have been added in order to allow players to customize their fishing experience more to their liking. notes.title: Meet the Characters of Mystic Fishing! Part 2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45497317/325b774f268fc747c17f10ad22594e052f87d317.png[/img]

The world of Mystic Fishing is filled with fun and interesting characters for you to find. There is even heart-to-heart events where you can fulfil quests, give gifts, or just have a nice chat.

We'll explore some of these characters in a two part news announcement. Today we start with our two main characters!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45497317/ab823fe22ea6df77e551216934c7cd1b9318a956.png[/img]

A mysterious boy who lives in the ruins off the coast of the sea. He says he is investigating the many Seaside Ruins across Concordia, searching for answers about The Deep. His past years of research brings him ever closer to unlocking the mysteries of the mutated fish and their origins. Though he shares the same goal as the protagonists, can he be trusted?


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45497317/343b7a8ab6d442574363e68bb6d16646e1c4e5ed.png[/img]

Known as the Goddess Born From the Sea, Lapis is known far and wide across Concordia as a saint, due to her benevolence and tender-heartedness. Lapis, unlike her older sister, loves everything about the mortal realm. When not locked away in the Seascape Palace, she often spends her time people-watching, observing their daily lives. When Seafarers pray to the divines, Lapis is the one who answers.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45497317/cf2317459730d53509ee6f0257a126ceb3fb591f.png[/img]

Known as the Goddess Born From the Stars, Lazuli is much unlike her sister. Her disdain for humans and short temper have earned her a reputation of being fear by most mortals. Wielding a massive fish hook as her weapon of choice, she spends most her days at the bottom of the ocean, driving back The Deep. Despite her cold demeanor, there's nothing she loves more in the world than her young sister.


[h2]End Note[/h2]

That concludes our character in-depth view! There are many other supporting characters all with their own quests and quirks for you to find in game! Next time, I want to talk more about the Land of Concordia where the game takes place, and it's origins and lore. Thank you for your support!

-Xinitii

notes.title: Meet the Characters of Mystic Fishing! Part 1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45497317/325b774f268fc747c17f10ad22594e052f87d317.png[/img]

The world of Mystic Fishing is filled with fun and interesting characters for you to find. There is even heart-to-heart events where you can fulfil quests, give gifts, or just have a nice chat.

We'll explore some of these characters in a two part news announcement. Today we start with our two main characters!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45497317/6a2277bdf30080f69d190f62eea295de118c367c.png[/img]

A young girl who grew up with her father in the small fishing village of Driftveil. She had lived most of her life secluded in the town, only leaving to fish at a nearby pond. Determined and strong willed, paired with a vast wanderlust, her father helps to set her off on her journey to explore the land of Concordia and become a master angler! Though her compassion and inability to abandon those in need end up roping her into a much bigger destiny.

Sakura has a strong will and the perseverance to overcome any obstacle. Her dream to become a master angler, like her father, and travel the world, like her mother. Though her bond with her father is very strong as he raised her, the circumstances around her mother and bit more obfuscated. There's an uneasy tension in the air whenever her mother is mentioned. Nevertheless, when she puts her trust and faith into her partner Kiara, there's nothing they can't accomplish!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45497317/f5ff677f10321acbdb27b9ceceba5c1f780b1ba6.png[/img]

Deftly skilled with a fishing spear, Kiara is apart of the Seafaring Tribe. A race of non-humans who have a natural strong connection to the sea and Oceanic Elements. Unable to sit still for even a moment, this whirlwind of a girl has a heart of gold and only wishes to support her friends and family anyway she can. With her natural sense of the elements, she helps Sakura blossom her voyage into something much more grand.

Kiara is a chaotic storm with a heart of gold. She's constantly all over the place and more than handful when it comes to keeping her still. On top of this, she never misses a chance to speak her mind, though it sometimes comes out a little blunt. Though when paired with Sakura, Kiara manages to contain herself more and follow lead. Kiara also seems to have somewhat of a crush on Sakura after being promised travelling the world together. Out of the multitude of things this girl never stops talking about, this is one situation where she is quietly reserved. You'll never meet a more trustworthy and dependable friend than her.

[h2]End Note[/h2]

That's all for this view of the characters. Next time I'll post a Part 2 detailing a few other important characters that this duo will meet throughout the story! Thank you for your support, as always.

-Xinitii

notes.title: Mystic Fishing: A Fantasy RPG - DEMO AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45497317/34a8b544b87e1258702211a1c7e74fd2a1b002b2.png[/img]
Hello everybody, my name is Xinitii.

Today I am happy to announce that I have finally pushed through a brand new [b]DEMO[/b] for [i]Mystic Fishing![/i]

I've been working hard on this demo and I'm so glad to finally be able to share it with you all.

[h3]Demo Covers:[/h3]

🎣First 3 Fishing Biomes of the game

🎣19 Total Fish (Including 15 regular fish, 3 unique aberrations. and a special boss fish)

🎣Post-demo Special Boss with increased difficulty (seriously)

🎣Over 10+ fishing skills for you to try out

🎣About 1hr and 30mins of story and dialogue (more if you engage in side content)

🎣Random events scattered across the world to find

🎣A "Fish Book" cataloguing all fish able to be caught in the demo

🎣9 different achievements to collect!

In the full release, these same biomes will contain even more fish (about double the demo's amount), there will be a [i]Fishing Encyclopedia [/i]which will be a book containing a full page of art and real life facts about each fish in the game, and also around 90-100+ fish to catch (both real and fantastical)! Along with around 10+ fishing biomes, side quests, and special heart-to-heart events, the full game will have lots of fun content to interact with!

I am a solo dev on this project, so please be kind about any bugs or grammar mistakes. That being said, I'd appreciate any and all feedback you may have for me. I'm working very hard on this project and would love to hear what you have to say.

I really hope you enjoy my demo and wishlist the game if you are interested! Thank you for your support.

-Xinitii

notes.title: Mystic Fishing Steam Page is Now Live!
notes.notes:
Hello everybody, my name is Xinitii.

I'm a sci-fi/ fantasy author that's always loved video games ever since I was a kid. After years of attempts and learning, I've finally decided to really put my all into making my first ever video game! I've been working on this project non stop for the past few months now. It's been a very fun and rewarding experience and I'm so glad to be able to finally talk about it.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3511450/Mystic_Fishing_A_Fantasy_Fishing_RPG/]Mystic Fishing[/url] is a fantasy fishing RPG inspired by games such as [i]River King: Mystic Valley, Dredge, and Deep Horrors of Fishing[/i]. It is a story driven game with Lovecraftian elements mixed in. There's lots of good character dialogue and fun moments too! The writing style for a few random events scattered throughout are inspired by Etrian Odyssey, one of my favorite game series of all time.

I'm am hard at working implementing all my ideas and digitally drawing each and every fish in this game. Right now I have about 10 diverse biomes planned with around 5-10 fish per area. Please stay tuned for more updates in the future as I flesh out more of this game!

-Xinitii
